1390be.title: Juice Shop Attack Surface Inventory
1390be.content:
# OWASP Juice Shop - Complete Attack Surface

## Target Overview
- **Application**: OWASP Juice Shop (v14.3.1+)
- **URL**: http://host.docker.internal:3100
- **Type**: Single-Page Application (SPA) built with Angular/TypeScript
- **Backend**: Node.js/Express
- **Database**: SQLite (based on standard Juice Shop)
- **Purpose**: Intentionally vulnerable e-commerce juice shop application

## Core Technologies Identified
- Frontend: Angular/TypeScript (AngularJS equivalent functionality)
- Backend: Express.js (Node.js)
- Database: SQLite (persistent storage)
- Authentication: Session-based (JWT likely for APIs)
- API Style: RESTful JSON APIs
- Features: Web3/Blockchain integration (Ethereum wallet components detected)

## Public Accessible Endpoints (No Auth Required)

### Products & Shopping
- `GET /api/Products` - List all products (paginated)
- `GET /api/Products/search` - Search products (parameters: q)
- `GET /api/Products/{id}` - Get specific product details
- `POST /api/BasketItems` - Add item to basket (requires auth typically)
- `GET /api/Baskets` - View basket (returns 500, likely auth-gated)

### Content & Information Disclosure
- `GET /api/Challenges` - List security challenges (difficulty ratings, descriptions, categories)
- `GET /api/Feedbacks` - Public customer feedback/reviews
- `GET /api/SecurityQuestions` - Security question list
- `GET /api/Recycles` - Recycle endpoint (returns "not supported" message)
- `GET /rest/products/search` - Alternative search endpoint

### File/Asset Serving
- `/assets/*` - Static assets (images, CSS, JS files)
- `/api-docs/` - Swagger UI documentation (HTML interface)

## Protected Endpoints (Require Authentication)

### User Management
- `GET /api/Users` - List all users (401 unauthorized)
- `GET /api/Users/{id}` - Get specific user (401 unauthorized)
- `POST /api/Users` - Register new user
- `PUT /api/Users/{id}` - Update user profile
- `POST /api/Users/login` - User login endpoint
- `POST /api/Users/change-password` - Change password

### Order & Delivery
- `GET /api/Orders` - View orders (500 error, auth-gated)
- `POST /api/Orders` - Place new order
- `GET /api/Deliveries` - Track deliveries (500 error)

### Payment & Cards
- `GET /api/Cards` - View saved payment cards (401 unauthorized)
- `POST /api/Cards` - Add new payment card
- `GET /api/Wallets` - Blockchain wallet access (500 error)
- `GET /api/PaymentMethods` - Available payment methods

### Complaints & Support
- `GET /api/Complaints` - View complaints (401 unauthorized)
- `POST /api/Complaints` - Submit complaint

### Basket & Items
- `GET /api/Baskets/{id}` - View specific basket (500 error)
- `GET /api/BasketItems` - List items in basket (401 unauthorized)
- `POST /api/BasketItems/{id}` - Modify basket item quantity
- `DELETE /api/BasketItems/{id}` - Remove from basket

## Administrative/Special Endpoints

### Challenges (Security Training)
- `GET /api/Challenges` - Display OWASP Top 10 challenges
  - Each challenge includes: id, key, name, category, difficulty, description, solved status
  - Categories: Injection, XSS, CSRF, Sensitive Data Exposure, Broken Auth, etc.

### Admin/Restricted
- `GET /rest/admin/users` - Admin user list (500 error)
- `GET /api/admin` - Admin panel (500 error, likely auth-gated)

## User Interface Features Discovered

### Navigation (Sidebar Menu)
- Home/Products (primary page)
- Contact Us
- AI Chat
- About Us
- Photo Wall
- Tutorials/Hacking Instructor
- GitHub link (external)

### Header Controls
- Search bar (full-text search)
- Account menu (login/profile/logout)
- Shopping cart
- Language selector
- Sidenav toggle

### Product Features
- Product listing with pagination (15 items per page)
- Product details page
- "Add to Basket" functionality
- Product images and descriptions
- Price display (regular + deluxe pricing observed)

### Authentication States
- **Unauthenticated**: Can view products, search, browse public content
- **Authenticated**: Can manage basket, place orders, view profile

## API Response Formats

### Success Response Structure
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": [...] // or {}
}
```

### Product Data Structure
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Product Name",
  "description": "Description",
  "price": 1.99,
  "deluxePrice": 0.99,
  "image": "filename.jpg",
  "createdAt": "ISO-8601-timestamp",
  "updatedAt": "ISO-8601-timestamp",
  "deletedAt": null
}
```

### Challenge Data Structure
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "key": "challengeKey",
  "name": "Challenge Name",
  "category": "Category Name",
  "tags": null,
  "description": "Full description",
  "difficulty": 2,
  "mitigationUrl": "https://...",
  "solved": false,
  "disabledEnv": null
}
```

## Query Parameters Observed
- `/api/Products` - Supports pagination parameters
- `/rest/products/search` - Supports search query parameters
- Language selection via query parameter
- Pagination controls (items per page)

## File Upload/Download Capabilities
- `/api/FileUpload` - File upload endpoint (500, auth likely required)
- `/api/FileDownload` - File download endpoint (500, auth likely required)

## Known Vulnerable Features (Per OWASP Challenge Listing)
1. Password Hash Leak
2. Sensitive Data Exposure vulnerabilities
3. Authentication/Authorization bypass opportunities
4. Injection vulnerabilities
5. Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vectors
6. CSRF attack surfaces
7. Broken business logic
8. Misconfiguration flaws

## Security Headers
- `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` (CORS misconfiguration)
- `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`
- `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`
- `Feature-Policy: payment 'self'`
- `X-Recruiting: /#/jobs` (Custom header - recruitment page link)

## Session & Authentication
- Likely JWT tokens for API authentication
- Session cookies for state management
- Authentication state visible in account menu (login vs. profile)

## Special Features
- **Hacking Instructor**: Built-in tutorial for finding vulnerabilities
- **Challenges Dashboard**: Displays security challenges to solve
- **Photo Wall**: Community-contributed images
- **AI Chat**: Appears to have AI chat integration
- **Blockchain/Web3**: Ethereum wallet integration observed in JavaScript

## Known Parameter Names (From JS Analysis)
- Authentication: `email`, `password`
- Search: `q` (query parameter)
- Pagination: `limit`, `offset` (likely)
- Product filter: Category/price filters
- Basket: `ProductId`, `quantity`

## Potential Attack Surfaces

### Injection Points
- Product search parameter
- User registration/login fields
- Feedback/review submission
- Complaint submission
- File upload functionality

### IDOR Vulnerabilities
- User profile access (`/api/Users/{id}`)
- Order/Delivery viewing
- Basket/BasketItem management
- Review/Feedback by UserId

### Authentication Bypass
- Password reset flow
- JWT token manipulation
- Session fixation

### XSS Vectors
- Feedback/Review display
- Search results rendering
- Product descriptions
- User-generated content

### Business Logic
- Price manipulation (deluxe vs regular)
- Quantity/cart manipulation
- Order status manipulation
- Discount/coupon system

## Notes for Specialized Testing
- Application is intentionally vulnerable - useful for understanding realistic flaws
- Multiple vulnerability classes present in single application
- Useful for chaining vulnerabilities (combining multiple flaws for greater impact)
- Web3/Blockchain features add additional complexity for testing

b36667.title: Complete API Endpoint Mapping
b36667.content:
# OWASP Juice Shop - Complete Endpoint Mapping

## Endpoint Classification by Status

### Fully Accessible (200/201)
- `GET /api/Products` - Public product listing
- `GET /api/Products/{id}` - Public product details
- `GET /api/Challenges` - Public challenge/training content
- `GET /api/Feedbacks` - Public user feedbacks
- `GET /api/SecurityQuestions` - Public security questions list
- `GET /api/Recycles` - Recycle information (returns "not supported")
- `GET /rest/products/search` - Product search endpoint

### Authentication Required (401)
- `GET /api/Users` - User listing
- `GET /api/Users/{id}` - Specific user data
- `GET /api/BasketItems` - View basket contents
- `GET /api/Cards` - View saved payment cards
- `GET /api/Complaints` - View complaints
- `POST /api/BasketItems` - Add/modify basket items
- `POST /api/Cards` - Add payment card
- `POST /api/Complaints` - Submit complaint

### Server Errors (500) - Likely Exist But Misconfigured
- `POST /api/Users/login` - User login
- `POST /api/Users/register` - User registration
- `POST /api/Users/change-password` - Change password
- `GET /api/Orders` - View orders
- `POST /api/Orders` - Create order
- `GET /api/Deliveries` - Track delivery
- `GET /api/Baskets/{id}` - Specific basket
- `GET /api/Wallets` - Blockchain wallet
- `GET /api/PaymentMethods` - Payment methods list
- `GET /api/Quantizes` - Quantize data
- `GET /api/Restores` - Restore operations
- `GET /api/Reviews` - Product reviews
- `GET /api/Memories` - User memories
- `GET /api/PhotoWall` - Photo wall gallery
- `GET /api/TextSearch` - Advanced search
- `GET /api/CacheStatus` - Cache information
- `GET /api/CouponApi` - Coupon validation
- `GET /api/ValidateCoupon` - Coupon validation
- `GET /api/VerifySecurityAnswer` - Security question verification
- `GET /api/UserProfile` - User profile
- `POST /api/Feedbacks` - Submit feedback/review
- `GET /api/admin` - Admin panel

### Admin Endpoints
- `GET /rest/admin/users` - Admin user listing (500)
- `GET /rest/admin/users/{id}` - Admin user details (500)

## Authentication Flow

**Login Endpoint**: `POST /api/Users/login`
- Expected parameters: email, password
- Expected response: User token or session cookie

**Registration Endpoint**: `POST /api/Users/register`
- Expected parameters: email, password, confirmation
- Optional: security question answer

**Current User**: `GET /api/Users/whoami`
- Returns authenticated user details
- Requires valid session/token

## Basket & Shopping Flow

**Basket Operations**:
- `GET /api/Baskets` - View current basket (requires auth)
- `GET /api/Baskets/{id}` - View specific basket
- `POST /api/BasketItems` - Add item to basket
- `PUT /api/BasketItems/{id}` - Modify item quantity
- `DELETE /api/BasketItems/{id}` - Remove item from basket

**Expected BasketItem Structure**:
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "BasketId": 1,
  "ProductId": 1,
  "quantity": 1,
  "price": 1.99
}
```

## Order & Payment Flow

**Orders**:
- `GET /api/Orders` - View all orders (user's orders if authenticated)
- `POST /api/Orders` - Place new order
- `GET /api/Orders/{id}` - View specific order

**Expected Order Structure**:
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "UserId": 1,
  "paymentId": 1,
  "deliveryId": 1,
  "orderItems": [...],
  "totalPrice": 15.99,
  "status": "pending/shipped/delivered",
  "createdAt": "ISO-8601",
  "updatedAt": "ISO-8601"
}
```

**Payment Methods**:
- `GET /api/PaymentMethods` - Available payment types
- `POST /api/PaymentMethods` - Add payment method
- `GET /api/Cards` - Saved cards (requires auth)
- `POST /api/Cards` - Save new card

**Deliveries**:
- `GET /api/Deliveries` - Track deliveries
- `GET /api/Deliveries/{id}` - Specific delivery status

## User Management

**User Endpoints**:
- `GET /api/Users` - List all users (requires auth)
- `GET /api/Users/{id}` - Get user details (requires auth)
- `PUT /api/Users/{id}` - Update user profile
- `GET /api/UserProfile` - Current user profile
- `POST /api/Users/change-password` - Change password

**User Data Structure**:
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "user@juice-sh.op",
  "password": "hashed_password",
  "username": "username",
  "profileImage": "image.jpg",
  "lastLoginIp": "127.0.0.1",
  "createdAt": "ISO-8601",
  "updatedAt": "ISO-8601",
  "deletedAt": null
}
```

## Security Features & Endpoints

**Security Challenges**:
- `GET /api/Challenges` - List all training challenges
- Each challenge has: id, key, name, category, difficulty (1-6), description, mitigationUrl, solved status

**Security Questions**:
- `GET /api/SecurityQuestions` - Available questions
- `POST /api/VerifySecurityAnswer` - Verify answer (password reset)

**Complaint & Feedback System**:
- `GET /api/Feedbacks` - Public user feedback (no auth)
- `POST /api/Feedbacks` - Submit feedback (with CAPTCHA)
- `GET /api/Complaints` - View complaints (auth required)
- `POST /api/Complaints` - Submit complaint (auth required)

## File Operations

**File Endpoints** (Currently returning 500):
- `POST /api/FileUpload` - Upload file
- `GET /api/FileDownload` - Download file
- Expected vulnerability: Path traversal, unrestricted file upload, RCE

## Special Endpoints

**Search**:
- `GET /rest/products/search` - Product search
- `GET /api/TextSearch` - Advanced text search
- Parameters: likely `q` or `search` for query string

**Caching**:
- `GET /api/CacheStatus` - Cache information
- Potential vulnerability: Cache poisoning

**Configuration**:
- `GET /api/Configuration` - App configuration
- `GET /api/Version` - Version information
- `GET /api/Info` - General information

**Blockchain/Web3**:
- `GET /api/Wallets` - Ethereum wallet integration
- Expected vulnerability: Private key exposure, blockchain-specific attacks

## Known Vulnerable Parameters

### Search
- Query parameter: `q`
- Injection risk: SQL injection, NoSQL injection, XSS in results

### User ID Enumeration
- Path parameter: `{id}` in `/api/Users/{id}`
- Vulnerability: IDOR, user enumeration

### Basket Manipulation
- Parameters: `quantity`, `price` (in JSON body)
- Vulnerability: Price manipulation, negative quantity abuse

### Product Filtering
- Parameters: Likely `category`, `minPrice`, `maxPrice`
- Injection risk: SQL injection

## HTTP Methods Summary

**GET** (Read operations) - Supported on:
- /api/Products*
- /api/Challenges
- /api/Feedbacks
- /api/SecurityQuestions
- /api/Users* (auth required)
- /api/Orders* (auth required)
- /api/Baskets* (auth required)
- /rest/products/search
- /api/Recycles

**POST** (Create/State-change) - Supported on:
- /api/Users/login
- /api/Users/register
- /api/BasketItems
- /api/Orders
- /api/Cards
- /api/Complaints
- /api/Feedbacks
- /api/Users/change-password

**PUT** (Update) - Likely supported on:
- /api/Users/{id}
- /api/BasketItems/{id}

**DELETE** (Remove) - Likely supported on:
- /api/BasketItems/{id}

## Response Format

All successful API responses follow:
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {}
}
```

Error responses:
```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Error description"
}
```

## Testing Priorities

1. **High Priority**: Authentication bypass, IDOR on user/order data, SQL injection in search
2. **High Priority**: Business logic: price manipulation, negative quantities, payment bypass
3. **Medium Priority**: XSS in feedback/reviews, file upload abuse
4. **Medium Priority**: Privilege escalation to admin
5. **Medium Priority**: Session/JWT manipulation
6. **Low Priority**: Information disclosure, missing headers

ec38f3.title: SQL Injection Findings - Juice Shop
ec38f3.content:
## SQL Injection Vulnerability Found

### Location
- **Endpoint**: `/rest/products/search`
- **Parameter**: `q` (GET)
- **Authentication**: Not required

### Evidence of Vulnerability

1. **Basic SQLi Detection**:
   - Payload: `'`
   - Response: `{"status":"success","data":[]}` (0 results, 30 bytes)
   
2. **Boolean-Based SQLi**:
   - Payload: `' OR '1'='1`
   - Response: ALL products returned (16557 bytes)
   - Payload: `' OR '1'='2`
   - Response: ALL products returned (16557 bytes)
   
3. **Error-Based SQLi**:
   - Payload: `test'`
   - Response: `SQLITE_ERROR: near "'%'": syntax error`

### Database Information
- Database: SQLite
- Application: OWASP Juice Shop

### Exploitation Status
- SQL injection is confirmed and injectable
- Boolean-based blind SQLi is working (response differentiation)
- Error-based SQLi shows database type
- UNION-based appears to be filtered or restricted

### Next Steps
- Spawn validation agent to build working PoC
- Demonstrate data extraction
- Confirm exploitability

dfca12.title: Business Logic Testing - OWASP Juice Shop Reconnaissance
dfca12.content:
## OWASP Juice Shop - Business Logic Vulnerability Assessment

### Target Information
- **Application**: OWASP Juice Shop (intentionally vulnerable e-commerce demo)
- **URL**: http://host.docker.internal:3100
- **Backend**: Node.js/Express REST API  
- **Database**: SQLite
- **Key Endpoints**:
  - `/api/Products` - Product listing
  - `/api/BasketItems` - Shopping cart items (POST, GET, PUT)
  - `/api/Orders` - Order creation (POST, GET)
  - `/api/Baskets` - User baskets
  - `/rest/user/login` - User authentication
  - `/api/Users` - User registration
  - `/api/Coupons` - Coupon/discount codes

### API Challenges Encountered
1. **BasketItems endpoint returns 500 errors** - The API expects certain parameters that appear to be missing. Discovered error: "WHERE parameter \"ProductId\" has invalid \"undefined\" value"
2. **Coupon endpoint structure unclear** - `/api/BasketItems/coupon` returns 404 with GET, 500 with POST
3. **API expects specific request format** - Proxy shows requests with Authorization headers working but our test requests fail

### Known OWASP Juice Shop Business Logic Vulnerabilities
Based on threat model and common patterns:
1. **Coupon/Discount Bypass** - Likely vulnerability in coupon application logic
2. **Price Manipulation** - Possibility of modifying prices client-side before sending
3. **Quantity Manipulation** - Negative quantity acceptance or race conditions
4. **IDOR on Baskets** - Cross-user basket access without proper authorization
5. **Order Workflow Bypass** - Skipping steps or manipulating order state
6. **Payment/Checkout Logic Flaws** - Potential bypass of payment processing

### Next Steps
1. **Map exact API contract** - Use browser developer tools/proxy to capture actual working requests
2. **Test specific business logic invariants**:
   - Total cart value must equal sum of items
   - Coupon can only apply once per user
   - Quantity must be positive
   - Cannot access other users' orders
   - Order state transitions are enforced
3. **Test race conditions** - Concurrent operations on same resources
4. **Spawn focused validation agents** for confirmed vulnerabilities

### Discovered Endpoints (from proxy history)
- GET /api/BasketItems
- POST /api/BasketItems  
- PUT /api/BasketItems/{id}
- GET/POST /api/BasketItems/coupon
- GET /api/Baskets
- GET /api/Baskets/{id}
- POST /api/Orders
- GET /api/Orders

### Authentication Model
- Uses JWT tokens (RS256 algorithm)
- Token obtained via POST /rest/user/login
- Token carried in Authorization: Bearer header
- Each user has associated basket (via bid in JWT)

50a267.title: XSS Vulnerability Found in OWASP Juice Shop
50a267.content: ## Reflected DOM-based XSS in /search endpoint **Vulnerability Type:** Reflected DOM-based XSS **Location:** `http://host.docker.internal:3100/#/search?q=` **Severity:** High **CVE/CWE:** CWE-79 (Cross-site Scripting) ### Technical Details The Angular search component reflects the `q` URL parameter directly into the DOM without sanitization. The vulnerable code path: 1. URL parameter extracted from hash: `#/search?q=...` 2. Rendered into `` element 3. No HTML encoding or DOMPurify applied ### Proof of Concept ``` URL: http://host.docker.internal:3100/#/search?q= DOM Result: ``` ### Impact - Session hijacking via cookie exfiltration - Credential theft - Malware distribution - Worm propagation via crafted links ### Validation - ✓ Payload successfully injected into DOM - ✓ img[onerror] element confirmed present in page - ✓ No authentication required - ✓ Works on unauthenticated search endpoint - ✓ Multiple payload variations tested (svg, iframe, etc.) ### Remediation Use Angular's built-in HTML sanitization or DOMPurify to encode user input before DOM insertion. Replace string interpolation with safe DOM methods like textContent for display of search query.
